_comment: Baseline snapshot: the TaintBench finding IDs ctadl detects today via a connected source->sink path. 10 of the 25 positive flows connect. Every finding's source and sink is recognized as an endpoint. ctadl reports the negative(s) [26, 27, 28] as flows. That is imprecision we have measured and written down here; a negative outside this list still fails the check. See ../../README.md.
